name: Scoped Coding-Agent Instruction Stack
mechanism: Separates current task constraints, stable repository instructions, nested package rules and product-specific adapters so only applicable verified guidance enters the coding agent context.
use_when: A repository is used with one or more coding-agent products
Project commands conventions and protected boundaries must persist across sessions
avoid_when: The task is a one-off outside a maintained repository
The target agent surface does not support or has not been tested for the chosen instruction files
The proposed content is a generic repository overview with no observed project deficit
expected_effects: Lower rediscovery cost and fewer project-convention errors on the measured task slices
Smaller applicable context than one monolithic instruction file
failure_modes: Conflicting nested rules cause nondeterministic behavior
A product or cloud surface discovers different files than expected
Copied documentation becomes stale while appearing authoritative
Context bloat increases tokens without improving correctness
Rules duplicate deterministic lint or leak task-specific procedures into always-loaded context
Final task success hides violation of an individual operational rule
required_evals: paired representative task comparison with and without instructions
stale conflict lint leakage and context-budget regression test
